description: Protocol parameters. Every value is an input cited from its implementer's documentation or a published construction, as listed in the references of paper/where_the_capital_bound_moves.md in the Spiral repository. None is a measurement and none is a constant in code.

exit_csv_blocks.note: unilateral exit relative timelock, about 24 hours

refresh_lead_blocks.note: refresh two days before expiry, the assumption of the cited simulation

forfeit_policy.value: forfeits cover refreshes and on-chain payments; Lightning payments use HTLC-based policies

assert_vb.note: BitVM3 Assert transaction, approximate, as published

disprove_vb.note: BitVM3 Disprove transaction, approximate, as published

garbled_verifier_gb.note: off-chain garbled Groth16 verifier; informational, no v0 task reads it

garbled_evaluation_minutes.note: informational, no v0 task reads it

not_parameters.R6: Bitcoin Optech Ark topic page: timeline and collusion caveat. Cited in the paper; no v0 task reads a value from it.
not_parameters.R8: Bitcoin Optech OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY topic page: no covenant opcode active. Cited in the paper; no v0 task reads a value from it.
not_parameters.R9: BlockEden, Bitcoin's Covenant Renaissance: secondary source for proposed activation parameters. Cited in the paper; no v0 task reads a value from it.
